maintenance_led.reason: Sells reagents, proteins, instruments and testing kits as consumable research products, not repair or servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are pharma, biotech, clinical labs and academic researchers; much academic funding is public but most revenue is commercial.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own product innovation and sales across R&D Systems, Novus, ACD and ProteinSimple, with occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: GMP cytokines, media and assay reagents are qualified into customers' cell therapy and diagnostic workflows; switching needs revalidation.

notes: Academic customers are partly government-funded, so the publicly_funded answer is a judgment call.
